_comment: Flux vector logo prompt templates. Edit strings here; variable substitution happens at runtime. Available variables: {brand} (uppercase brand name), {concept} (visual concept element — pre-formatted string with leading space, or empty), {colors} (full color instruction string), {bg} (background instruction string), {shape_block} (shape constraint sentence, or empty string), {no_text} (text constraint — pre-formatted string with leading space).
shape_block: Hard shape constraint: the entire logo is fully enclosed inside a perfect {SHAPE} container. Nothing extends outside the {Shape}.

default_colors.minimal_geometric: navy blue and gold color palette.
default_colors.abstract: navy blue and gold color palette.
default_colors.monoline: navy blue and gold color palette.
default_colors.negative_space: navy blue and gold color palette.
default_colors.tech_gradient: vibrant gradient colors from cyan to purple.
default_colors.real_estate_home: red, deep blue, white, and charcoal color palette.
default_colors.skyline_swoosh: deep blue, bright cyan, warm orange, and charcoal color palette.
default_colors.nature_landscape: forest green, pine green, warm sunrise orange, soft yellow, and dark charcoal color palette.
default_colors.modern_sans: navy blue and gold color palette.
default_colors.bold_geometric: deep charcoal and electric blue color palette.
default_colors.elegant_serif: midnight blue and muted gold color palette.
default_colors.script_signature: rich black and warm gold color palette.
default_colors.tech_mono: slate gray and neon cyan color palette.
default_colors.minimal_light: soft charcoal and light gray color palette.

no_text.icon_only: ICON ONLY. Do not create company names, brand names, taglines, labels, signs, captions, letters, numbers, initials, fake words, or any readable characters. Pure graphic symbol only.
no_text.with_brand: The ONLY text in the entire image is "{brand}". Do not add any other words, letters, taglines, slogans, or captions anywhere in the image.
no_text.text_only: The ONLY text in the image is "{brand}". No icons, symbols, marks, pictograms, or decorative graphics.

quality_vector.min: Final detail rule: low detail overrides any earlier ornate or complex style wording. Use very simple flat 2D SVG-ready shapes, solid fills, bold silhouette, minimal paths, minimal anchors, no gradients, no shadows, no texture, no tiny details, and no dense ornament.
quality_vector.medium: Final detail rule: medium detail overrides any earlier max-detail or ornate style wording. Use clean vector geometry with moderate path detail, restrained internal cuts, controlled linework, and readable shapes. Avoid dense ornament, tiny details, gradients, shadows, texture, and max-detail complexity.
quality_vector.max: Smooth lines, clean curves, and balanced vector geometry.

Minimal geometric design.{no_text} Use clean vector-style shapes with crisp edges and smooth Bezier curves suitable for SVG output.

icon_only.real_estate_home: Icon-only modern real estate vector symbol.{concept} Make the subject read immediately as premium property or real estate using simplified building silhouettes, window grids, doors, keys, map pins, land parcel shapes, skyline geometry, or clean property-brand forms. Use crisp angular geometry, confident negative space, balanced horizontal proportions, and generous white space. Prefer deep navy, white, charcoal, and restrained warm accent colors when colors are not fixed. {colors} Clean flat SVG-style artwork, centered 1:1 composition, {bg}. {shape_block} Avoid people, abstract monograms, maze-like geometry, circular emblems, ambiguous symbols, and decorative flowing underline strokes unless the prompt specifically asks for them.{no_text}
icon_only.skyline_swoosh: Icon-only modern real estate vector symbol.{concept} When the prompt asks for roofs, sun, or swoosh, use a sleek angular roofline composition with crisp navy planes, small square window cutouts, a restrained warm orange sunburst behind the form, and an optional smooth blue baseline stroke. Keep it airy, premium, horizontally balanced, and SVG-clean. {colors} Clean flat SVG-style artwork, centered 1:1 composition, {bg}. {shape_block} Avoid chunky house clip art, thick cartoon outlines, clutter, text, labels, people, and photorealism.{no_text}
icon_only.nature_landscape: Icon-only nature vector symbol.{concept} Create an unmistakable outdoor landscape mark with actual trees or forest silhouettes and a visible rising sun on the horizon when requested. Preserve any requested season: winter uses snow, bare branches, frosty ground, and cool whites/blues; spring uses blossoms, new leaves, flowers, and fresh light greens; autumn or fall uses orange, red, and gold leaves with warm earth tones; summer uses lush green foliage and bright warm sun only when summer is requested. The subject must read as nature immediately, not as a generic eco, utility, or wellness symbol. Use layered tree forms, trunks, branches, leaves, hills, ground line, and seasonal sun or sky cues. {colors} Clean flat SVG-style artwork, centered 1:1 composition, {bg}. {shape_block} Avoid light bulbs, water droplets, flames, abstract drops, generic recycle symbols, random icons, people, buildings, text, letters, and photorealism.{no_text}
